text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The final crown of the Classic Triple 
Crown races... With the audience's high 
expectations for the Kikuka-sho, Kyoto 
Racecourse had turned into a festival.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And speaking of the most central topic—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
—Hmm, so this girl named Air Shakur is 
really strong, huh.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! She really stands out in this 
generation, doesn't she? Though part of 
that is because the other girls haven't 
stepped up yet.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
So this year's going to belong to her 
generation? ...That's kinda amazing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Through all the training up to this point, 
she has successfully reached the 
theoretical level needed to win the Kikuka 
Sho. However...
choice_data_list: I wonder what kind of race today will be

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Whatever 'Parcae' showed before can't be 
relied on anymore.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I have no choice but to memorize every 
simulated pattern.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Track condition, state of the lineup, race 
development shifts... I've factored in at 
least a hundred combinations for now.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
This is finally enough. To deal with the 
unknown, that is.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Destiny's already changed. Instead of 
going where I get pushed into, I'll carve 
my own damn way to victory."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'll find that path, without fail. So this 
won't be my final glory.
